# GENERATED by _tools/goods/build_goods.py from goods.csv + templates.txt - do not edit by hand.

# Consumer goods trade templates: expanded by _tools/goods/build_goods.py into
# common/scripted_effects/CWIC_Goods_Generated_Effects.txt. One block per family, repeated for every good in goods.csv.
# Placeholders: <cg_snake_t> cg_consumer_electronics_t1 | <cg_name_t> cg_electronics_t1 | <CgCatT> CgBasicT1 | <cgCatT> cgBasicT1 | <CatT> BasicT1 | <cg_snake_> cg_basic_ | <cg_cat_> cg_basic_ | <_t> _t1
#               <price_key> (price_adjust_<price_key> array) | <cut_event> (trade.N fired when over-sold)

# ===== generate_available_<cg_snake_t>_import_array
generate_available_cg_basic_t0_import_array = {
	clear_array = ROOT.cgBasicT0Exporters
	clear_array = ROOT.cgBasicT0ExporterInfo

	for_each_scope_loop = {  # was every_other_country; the pool holds every country that may sell (filtered exactly as before)
		array = global.cwic_cg_sellers_cg_basic_t0
		if = {
			limit = {
			exists = yes
			OR = {
				check_variable = { cg_basic_export_stock_t0 > 0.99 }
				check_variable = { currentExportedCgBasicT0 > 0.99 }
			}
			NOT = { tag = ROOT }
			check_variable = { ROOT.trade_embargo_check^THIS = 0 }
			NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
			}

		add_to_array = { ROOT.cgBasicT0Exporters = THIS.id }
		add_to_array = { ROOT.cgBasicT0ExporterInfo = THIS.cg_basic_export_stock_t0 }

		set_variable = { cgBasicT0ExportCash = global.cgBasicT0BasePrice }

		set_variable = { price_Adj = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { price_Adjuster = 0 }
		add_to_variable = { price_Adjuster = ROOT.price_adjust_cg_basic_t0^THIS }

		if = {
			limit = { is_subject_of = ROOT }
			set_variable = { price_Adj = modifier@extra_trade_to_overlord_factor }
			set_variable = { price_Adj2 = 1 }
			subtract_from_variable = { price_Adj2 = price_Adj }
			set_temp_variable = { price_Adjuster = 1 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { price_Adjuster = 1 } }
			multiply_variable = { cgBasicT0ExportCash = price_Adj }
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { ROOT.price_adjust_generic^THIS = 0 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { price_Adjuster = 0 }
			set_variable = { price_Adjuster_Special = ROOT.price_adjust_generic^THIS }
			set_variable = { price_Adj = price_Adjuster_Special }
			set_variable = { price_Adj2 = 1 }
			subtract_from_variable = { price_Adj2 = price_Adj }
			set_temp_variable = { price_Adjuster = 1 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { price_Adjuster = 1 } }
			multiply_variable = { cgBasicT0ExportCash = price_Adj }
		}

		set_variable = { price_adjustment_ideas = modifier@global_trade_penalty_adjustment }

		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = arab_league_member }
			add_to_variable = {
				price_adjustment_ideas = ROOT.modifier@arab_league_trade_penalty_adjustment
			}
		}

		add_to_variable = { price_adjustment_ideas = 1 }
		multiply_variable = { cgBasicT0ExportCash = price_adjustment_ideas }

		set_variable = { price_adjustment_ideas2 = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = {
			price_adjustment_ideas2 = modifier@global_trade_bonus_adjustment
		}
		multiply_variable = { cgBasicT0ExportCash = price_adjustment_ideas2 }

		# Shipping Cost
		set_temp_variable = { exporter_capital = capital }
		var:exporter_capital = {
			set_variable = { PREV.shipping_cost = distance_to@ROOT.capital }
		}

		divide_variable = { shipping_cost = global.base_shipping_cost_divisor_cg }
		multiply_variable = { shipping_cost = 100 }
		round_variable = shipping_cost
		divide_variable = { shipping_cost = 100 }

		set_temp_variable = { modifier_temp = shipping_cost_effect }
		add_to_temp_variable = { modifier_temp = 1 }
		multiply_variable = { shipping_cost = modifier_temp }
		add_to_variable = { shipping_cost = 1 }

		set_temp_variable = { true_price = cgBasicT0ExportCash }
		multiply_temp_variable = { true_price = shipping_cost }

		add_to_variable = { cgBasicT0ExportCash = true_price }

		clear_variable = price_Adjuster
		set_variable = { cgBasicT0ExporterPrice^ROOT = cgBasicT0ExportCash }
		}
	}
}

		multiply_variable = { cgBasicT5ExportCash = price_adjustment_ideas2 }

		# Shipping Cost
		set_temp_variable = { exporter_capital = capital }
		var:exporter_capital = {
			set_variable = { PREV.shipping_cost = distance_to@ROOT.capital }
		}

		divide_variable = { shipping_cost = global.base_shipping_cost_divisor_cg }
		multiply_variable = { shipping_cost = 100 }
		round_variable = shipping_cost
		divide_variable = { shipping_cost = 100 }

		set_temp_variable = { modifier_temp = shipping_cost_effect }
		add_to_temp_variable = { modifier_temp = 1 }
		multiply_variable = { shipping_cost = modifier_temp }
		add_to_variable = { shipping_cost = 1 }

		set_temp_variable = { true_price = cgBasicT5ExportCash }
		multiply_temp_variable = { true_price = shipping_cost }

		add_to_variable = { cgBasicT5ExportCash = true_price }

		clear_variable = price_Adjuster
		set_variable = { cgBasicT5ExporterPrice^ROOT = cgBasicT5ExportCash }
		}

generate_available_cg_durable_t0_import_array = {
	clear_array = ROOT.cgDurableT0Exporters
	clear_array = ROOT.cgDurableT0ExporterInfo

	for_each_scope_loop = {  # was every_other_country; the pool holds every country that may sell (filtered exactly as before)
		array = global.cwic_cg_sellers_cg_durable_t0

			limit = {
			exists = yes
			OR = {
				check_variable = { cg_durable_export_stock_t0 > 0.99 }
				check_variable = { currentExportedCgDurableT0 > 0.99 }
			}
			NOT = { tag = ROOT }
			check_variable = { ROOT.trade_embargo_check^THIS = 0 }
			NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
			}

		add_to_array = { ROOT.cgDurableT0Exporters = THIS.id }
		add_to_array = { ROOT.cgDurableT0ExporterInfo = THIS.cg_durable_export_stock_t0 }

		set_variable = { cgDurableT0ExportCash = global.cgDurableT0BasePrice }

		set_variable = { price_Adj = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { price_Adjuster = 0 }
		add_to_variable = { price_Adjuster = ROOT.price_adjust_cg_durable_t0^THIS }

		if = {
			limit = { is_subject_of = ROOT }
			set_variable = { price_Adj = modifier@extra_trade_to_overlord_factor }
			set_variable = { price_Adj2 = 1 }
			subtract_from_variable = { price_Adj2 = price_Adj }
			set_temp_variable = { price_Adjuster = 1 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { price_Adjuster = 1 } }
			multiply_variable = { cgDurableT0ExportCash = price_Adj }
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { ROOT.price_adjust_generic^THIS = 0 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { price_Adjuster = 0 }
			set_variable = { price_Adjuster_Special = ROOT.price_adjust_generic^THIS }
			set_variable = { price_Adj = price_Adjuster_Special }
			set_variable = { price_Adj2 = 1 }
			subtract_from_variable = { price_Adj2 = price_Adj }
			set_temp_variable = { price_Adjuster = 1 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { price_Adjuster = 1 } }
			multiply_variable = { cgDurableT0ExportCash = price_Adj }
		}

		set_variable = { price_adjustment_ideas = modifier@global_trade_penalty_adjustment }

		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = arab_league_member }
			add_to_variable = {
				price_adjustment_ideas = ROOT.modifier@arab_league_trade_penalty_adjustment
			}
		}

		add_to_variable = { price_adjustment_ideas = 1 }
		multiply_variable = { cgDurableT0ExportCash = price_adjustment_ideas }

		set_variable = { price_adjustment_ideas2 = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = {
			price_adjustment_ideas2 = modifier@global_trade_bonus_adjustment
		}
		multiply_variable = { cgDurableT0ExportCash = price_adjustment_ideas2 }

		# Shipping Cost
		set_temp_variable = { exporter_capital = capital }
		var:exporter_capital = {
			set_variable = { PREV.shipping_cost = distance_to@ROOT.capital }
		}

		divide_variable = { shipping_cost = global.base_shipping_cost_divisor_cg }
		multiply_variable = { shipping_cost = 100 }
		round_variable = shipping_cost
		divide_variable = { shipping_cost = 100 }

		set_temp_variable = { modifier_temp = shipping_cost_effect }
		add_to_temp_variable = { modifier_temp = 1 }
		multiply_variable = { shipping_cost = modifier_temp }
		add_to_variable = { shipping_cost = 1 }

		set_temp_variable = { true_price = cgDurableT0ExportCash }

			multiply_variable = { cgDurableT5ExportCash = price_Adj }
		}

		set_variable = { price_adjustment_ideas = modifier@global_trade_penalty_adjustment }

		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = arab_league_member }
			add_to_variable = {
				price_adjustment_ideas = ROOT.modifier@arab_league_trade_penalty_adjustment
			}
		}

		add_to_variable = { price_adjustment_ideas = 1 }
		multiply_variable = { cgDurableT5ExportCash = price_adjustment_ideas }

		set_variable = { price_adjustment_ideas2 = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = {
			price_adjustment_ideas2 = modifier@global_trade_bonus_adjustment
		}
		multiply_variable = { cgDurableT5ExportCash = price_adjustment_ideas2 }

		# Shipping Cost
		set_temp_variable = { exporter_capital = capital }
		var:exporter_capital = {
			set_variable = { PREV.shipping_cost = distance_to@ROOT.capital }
		}

		divide_variable = { shipping_cost = global.base_shipping_cost_divisor_cg }
		multiply_variable = { shipping_cost = 100 }
		round_variable = shipping_cost
		divide_variable = { shipping_cost = 100 }

		set_temp_variable = { modifier_temp = shipping_cost_effect }
		add_to_temp_variable = { modifier_temp = 1 }
		multiply_variable = { shipping_cost = modifier_temp }
		add_to_variable = { shipping_cost = 1 }

		set_temp_variable = { true_price = cgDurableT5ExportCash }

			set_variable = { price_Adj2 = 1 }
			subtract_from_variable = { price_Adj2 = price_Adj }
			set_temp_variable = { price_Adjuster = 1 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { price_Adjuster = 1 } }
			multiply_variable = { cgVehiclesT5ExportCash = price_Adj }
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { ROOT.price_adjust_generic^THIS = 0 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { price_Adjuster = 0 }
			set_variable = { price_Adjuster_Special = ROOT.price_adjust_generic^THIS }
			set_variable = { price_Adj = price_Adjuster_Special }
			set_variable = { price_Adj2 = 1 }
			subtract_from_variable = { price_Adj2 = price_Adj }
			set_temp_variable = { price_Adjuster = 1 }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { price_Adjuster = 1 } }
			multiply_variable = { cgVehiclesT5ExportCash = price_Adj }
		}

		set_variable = { price_adjustment_ideas = modifier@global_trade_penalty_adjustment }

		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = arab_league_member }
			add_to_variable = {
				price_adjustment_ideas = ROOT.modifier@arab_league_trade_penalty_adjustment
			}
		}

		add_to_variable = { price_adjustment_ideas = 1 }
		multiply_variable = { cgVehiclesT5ExportCash = price_adjustment_ideas }

		set_variable = { price_adjustment_ideas2 = 1 }
		subtract_from_variable = {
			price_adjustment_ideas2 = modifier@global_trade_bonus_adjustment
		}
		multiply_variable = { cgVehiclesT5ExportCash = price_adjustment_ideas2 }

		# Shipping Cost
		set_temp_variable = { exporter_capital = capital }
		var:exporter_capital = {
			set_variable = { PREV.shipping_cost = distance_to@ROOT.capital }
		}

		divide_variable = { shipping_cost = global.base_shipping_cost_divisor_cg }
		multiply_variable = { shipping_cost = 100 }
		round_variable = shipping_cost
		divide_variable = { shipping_cost = 100 }

		set_temp_variable = { modifier_temp = shipping_cost_effect }
		add_to_temp_variable = { modifier_temp = 1 }
		multiply_variable = { shipping_cost = modifier_temp }
		add_to_variable = { shipping_cost = 1 }

	clear_array = ROOT.cgElectronicsT1ExporterInfo

		array = global.cwic_cg_sellers_cg_consumer_electronics_t1

			limit = {

			OR = {

			NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
			}

		add_to_array = { ROOT.cgElectronicsT1Exporters = THIS.id }

		set_variable = { cgElectronicsT1ExportCash = global.cgElectronicsT1BasePrice }

		set_variable = { price_Adj = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { price_Adjuster = 0 }
		add_to_variable = { price_Adjuster = ROOT.price_adjust_cg_electronics_t1^THIS }

		if = {
			limit = { is_subject_of = ROOT }
			set_variable = { price_Adj = modifier@extra_trade_to_overlord_factor }
			set_variable = { price_Adj2 = 1 }

			set_temp_variable = { price_Adjuster = 1 }
		}

		}

			add_to_variable = {

			}
		}

		}
		multiply_variable = { cgElectronicsT1ExportCash = price_adjustment_ideas2 }

# ===== sort_price_number_<cg_name_t>
sort_price_number_cg_basic_t0 = {
	clear_array = cgBasicT0ExportPriceRate

	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cgBasicT0Exporters
		add_to_array = { 
			PREV.cgBasicT0ExportPriceRate = cgBasicT0ExporterPrice^ROOT
		}
	}

	clear_array = cgBasicT0CurrentImport

	every_other_country = { 
		for_loop_effect = {
			end = CgBasicT0ExportTarget^num
			value = v
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { CgBasicT0ExportTarget^v = ROOT.id }
				}
				add_to_array = { ROOT.cgBasicT0CurrentImport = CgBasicT0ExportTargetAmount^i }
			}
			else = {
				add_to_array = { ROOT.cgBasicT0CurrentImport = 0 }
			}
		}
	}

	# Creates the Sample Array
	resize_temp_array = {
		array = cgBasicT0ExporterInfo_temp
		size = cgBasicT0ExporterInfo^num
	}
	resize_temp_array = {
		array = cgBasicT0ExportPriceRate_temp
		size = cgBasicT0ExporterInfo^num
	}
	resize_temp_array = {
		array = cgBasicT0Exporters_temp
		size = cgBasicT0ExporterInfo^num
	}

	set_temp_variable = { start_temp = cgBasicT0ExportPriceRate^num }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { start_temp = 1 }

	for_loop_effect = {
		start = start_temp
		end = 0
		compare = greater_than_or_equals
		add = -1
		value = v

		find_highest_in_array = {
			array = cgBasicT0ExportPriceRate
			value = max
			index = max_index
		}

		set_temp_variable = { cgBasicT0ExportPriceRate_temp^v = max }
		set_temp_variable = { cgBasicT0ExporterInfo_temp^v = cgBasicT0Exporters^max_index }
		set_temp_variable = { cgBasicT0Exporters_temp^v = cgBasicT0Exporters^max_index }
		set_variable = { cgBasicT0ExportPriceRate^max_index = -1 }
	}

	clear_array = cgBasicT0ExporterInfo
	clear_array = cgBasicT0Exporters
	clear_array = cgBasicT0ExportPriceRate

	# Restores destroyed arrays in the above process
	for_each_loop = {
		array = cgBasicT0ExportPriceRate_temp
		add_to_array = { cgBasicT0ExportPriceRate = v }
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = cgBasicT0ExporterInfo_temp
		add_to_array = { cgBasicT0ExporterInfo = v }
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = cgBasicT0Exporters_temp
		add_to_array = { cgBasicT0Exporters = v }
	}

	clear_temp_array = cgBasicT0ExporterInfo_temp
	clear_temp_array = cgBasicT0Exporters_temp
	clear_temp_array = cgBasicT0ExportPriceRate_temp
}

	resize_temp_array = {
		array = cgDurableT2Exporters_temp
		size = cgDurableT2ExporterInfo^num
	}

	set_temp_variable = { start_temp = cgDurableT2ExportPriceRate^num }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { start_temp = 1 }

	for_loop_effect = {
		start = start_temp
		end = 0
		compare = greater_than_or_equals
		add = -1
		value = v

		find_highest_in_array = {
			array = cgDurableT2ExportPriceRate
			value = max
			index = max_index
		}

		set_temp_variable = { cgDurableT2ExportPriceRate_temp^v = max }
		set_temp_variable = { cgDurableT2ExporterInfo_temp^v = cgDurableT2Exporters^max_index }
		set_temp_variable = { cgDurableT2Exporters_temp^v = cgDurableT2Exporters^max_index }
		set_variable = { cgDurableT2ExportPriceRate^max_index = -1 }
	}

	clear_array = cgDurableT2ExporterInfo
	clear_array = cgDurableT2Exporters
	clear_array = cgDurableT2ExportPriceRate

	# Restores destroyed arrays in the above process
	for_each_loop = {
		array = cgDurableT2ExportPriceRate_temp
		add_to_array = { cgDurableT2ExportPriceRate = v }
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = cgDurableT2ExporterInfo_temp
		add_to_array = { cgDurableT2ExporterInfo = v }
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = cgDurableT2Exporters_temp
		add_to_array = { cgDurableT2Exporters = v }
	}

	clear_temp_array = cgDurableT2ExporterInfo_temp
	clear_temp_array = cgDurableT2Exporters_temp
	clear_temp_array = cgDurableT2ExportPriceRate_temp
}

		array = cgVehiclesT4ExportPriceRate_temp
		size = cgVehiclesT4ExporterInfo^num
	}
	resize_temp_array = {
		array = cgVehiclesT4Exporters_temp
		size = cgVehiclesT4ExporterInfo^num
	}

	set_temp_variable = { start_temp = cgVehiclesT4ExportPriceRate^num }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { start_temp = 1 }

	for_loop_effect = {
		start = start_temp
		end = 0
		compare = greater_than_or_equals
		add = -1
		value = v

		find_highest_in_array = {
			array = cgVehiclesT4ExportPriceRate
			value = max
			index = max_index
		}

		set_temp_variable = { cgVehiclesT4ExportPriceRate_temp^v = max }
		set_temp_variable = { cgVehiclesT4ExporterInfo_temp^v = cgVehiclesT4Exporters^max_index }
		set_temp_variable = { cgVehiclesT4Exporters_temp^v = cgVehiclesT4Exporters^max_index }
		set_variable = { cgVehiclesT4ExportPriceRate^max_index = -1 }
	}

	clear_array = cgVehiclesT4ExporterInfo
	clear_array = cgVehiclesT4Exporters
	clear_array = cgVehiclesT4ExportPriceRate

	# Restores destroyed arrays in the above process
	for_each_loop = {
		array = cgVehiclesT4ExportPriceRate_temp
		add_to_array = { cgVehiclesT4ExportPriceRate = v }
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = cgVehiclesT4ExporterInfo_temp
		add_to_array = { cgVehiclesT4ExporterInfo = v }
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = cgVehiclesT4Exporters_temp
		add_to_array = { cgVehiclesT4Exporters = v }
	}

	clear_temp_array = cgVehiclesT4ExporterInfo_temp
	clear_temp_array = cgVehiclesT4Exporters_temp
	clear_temp_array = cgVehiclesT4ExportPriceRate_temp
}

# ===== buy_<cg_name_t>
buy_cg_basic_t0 = {

	var:currentPurchaser = {
		for_loop_effect = {
			end = ROOT.CgBasicT0_Import_List
			value = v
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { CgBasicT0_Import_List^v = THIS.id }
				}
				set_country_flag = found
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
			add_to_array = { ROOT.CgBasicT0_Import_List = THIS.id }
		}
		clr_country_flag = found

		for_loop_effect = {
			end = CgBasicT0_Export_List
			value = v
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { CgBasicT0_Export_List^v = ROOT.id }
				}
				set_country_flag = found
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
			add_to_array = { CgBasicT0_Export_List = ROOT.id }
		}
		clr_country_flag = found

		subtract_from_variable = {
			ROOT.purchase_amount = ROOT.purchase_amount_prior
		}
		subtract_from_variable = {
			currentAvailableCgBasicT0Export = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_used = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		subtract_from_variable = {
			ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			currentExportedCgBasicT0 = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.cgBasicT0Imports = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		set_variable = {
			CgBasicT0ExportTarget^ROOT = ROOT.id
		} 
		add_to_variable = {
			CgBasicT0ExportTargetAmount^ROOT = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		set_variable = {
			price_of_goods = cgBasicT0ExporterPrice^ROOT
		}
		multiply_variable = {
			price_of_goods = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		add_to_variable = {
			CgBasicT0ExportTargetMonthly^ROOT = price_of_goods
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.CgBasicT0ImportTargetMonthly^THIS = price_of_goods
		}
		set_variable = {
			ROOT.CgBasicT0ImportTarget^THIS = THIS.id
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.CgBasicT0ImportTargetAmount^THIS = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		set_variable = {
			price_of_goods = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			ROOT.purchase_amount = 0
		}
	}

	every_other_country = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				cg_basic_export_stock_t0 > 0.99
			}
			NOT = {
				tag = ROOT
			}
			check_variable = {
				ROOT.trade_embargo_check^THIS = 0
			}
			NOT = {
				has_war_with = ROOT
			}
		}
		clear_array = CgBasicT0CurrentExport
		for_loop_effect = {
			end = CgBasicT0ExportTarget^num
			value = v
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { CgBasicT0ExportTarget^v = ROOT.id }
				}
				add_to_array = { CgBasicT0CurrentExport = CgBasicT0ExportTargetAmount^i }

			}
			else = {
				add_to_array = { CgBasicT0CurrentExport = 0 }

			}
		}
	}
}
buy_cg_basic_t1 = {

	var:currentPurchaser = {
		for_loop_effect = {
			end = ROOT.CgBasicT1_Import_List
			value = v
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { CgBasicT1_Import_List^v = THIS.id }
				}
				set_country_flag = found
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
			add_to_array = { ROOT.CgBasicT1_Import_List = THIS.id }
		}
		clr_country_flag = found

		for_loop_effect = {
			end = CgBasicT1_Export_List
			value = v
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { CgBasicT1_Export_List^v = ROOT.id }
				}
				set_country_flag = found
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
			add_to_array = { CgBasicT1_Export_List = ROOT.id }
		}
		clr_country_flag = found

		subtract_from_variable = {
			ROOT.purchase_amount = ROOT.purchase_amount_prior
		}
		subtract_from_variable = {
			currentAvailableCgBasicT1Export = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_used = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		subtract_from_variable = {
			ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			currentExportedCgBasicT1 = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.cgBasicT1Imports = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		set_variable = {
			CgBasicT1ExportTarget^ROOT = ROOT.id
		} 
		add_to_variable = {
			CgBasicT1ExportTargetAmount^ROOT = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		set_variable = {
			price_of_goods = cgBasicT1ExporterPrice^ROOT
		}
		multiply_variable = {
			price_of_goods = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		add_to_variable = {
			CgBasicT1ExportTargetMonthly^ROOT = price_of_goods
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.CgBasicT1ImportTargetMonthly^THIS = price_of_goods
		}
		set_variable = {
			ROOT.CgBasicT1ImportTarget^THIS = THIS.id
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.CgBasicT1ImportTargetAmount^THIS = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		set_variable = {
			price_of_goods = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			ROOT.purchase_amount = 0
		}
	}

	every_other_country = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				cg_basic_export_stock_t1 > 0.99
			}
			NOT = {
				tag = ROOT
			}
			check_variable = {
				ROOT.trade_embargo_check^THIS = 0
			}
			NOT = {
				has_war_with = ROOT
			}
		}
		clear_array = CgBasicT1CurrentExport
		for_loop_effect = {
			end = CgBasicT1ExportTarget^num
			value = v
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { CgBasicT1ExportTarget^v = ROOT.id }
				}
				add_to_array = { CgBasicT1CurrentExport = CgBasicT1ExportTargetAmount^i }

			}
			else = {
				add_to_array = { CgBasicT1CurrentExport = 0 }

			}
		}
	}
}

		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.CgDurableT1ImportTargetMonthly^THIS = price_of_goods
		}
		set_variable = {
			ROOT.CgDurableT1ImportTarget^THIS = THIS.id
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.CgDurableT1ImportTargetAmount^THIS = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		set_variable = {
			price_of_goods = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			ROOT.purchase_amount = 0
		}
	}

	every_other_country = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				cg_durable_export_stock_t1 > 0.99
			}
			NOT = {
				tag = ROOT
			}
			check_variable = {
				ROOT.trade_embargo_check^THIS = 0
			}
			NOT = {
				has_war_with = ROOT
			}
		}
		clear_array = CgDurableT1CurrentExport
		for_loop_effect = {
			end = CgDurableT1ExportTarget^num
			value = v
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { CgDurableT1ExportTarget^v = ROOT.id }
				}
				add_to_array = { CgDurableT1CurrentExport = CgDurableT1ExportTargetAmount^i }

			}

	var:currentPurchaser = {
		for_loop_effect = {
			end = ROOT.CgDurableT2_Import_List
			value = v
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { CgDurableT2_Import_List^v = THIS.id }
				}
				set_country_flag = found
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
			add_to_array = { ROOT.CgDurableT2_Import_List = THIS.id }
		}
		clr_country_flag = found

		for_loop_effect = {
			end = CgDurableT2_Export_List
			value = v
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { CgDurableT2_Export_List^v = ROOT.id }
				}
				set_country_flag = found
			}
		}
		if = {

			add_to_array = { CgDurableT2_Export_List = ROOT.id }
		}
		clr_country_flag = found

		subtract_from_variable = {
			ROOT.purchase_amount = ROOT.purchase_amount_prior
		}
		subtract_from_variable = {
			currentAvailableCgDurableT2Export = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_used = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		subtract_from_variable = {
			ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			currentExportedCgDurableT2 = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.cgDurableT2Imports = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		set_variable = {
			CgDurableT2ExportTarget^ROOT = ROOT.id
		} 
		add_to_variable = {
			CgDurableT2ExportTargetAmount^ROOT = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		set_variable = {
			price_of_goods = cgDurableT2ExporterPrice^ROOT
		}
		multiply_variable = {
			price_of_goods = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		add_to_variable = {
			CgDurableT2ExportTargetMonthly^ROOT = price_of_goods
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.CgDurableT2ImportTargetMonthly^THIS = price_of_goods
		}
		set_variable = {
			ROOT.CgDurableT2ImportTarget^THIS = THIS.id
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.CgDurableT2ImportTargetAmount^THIS = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		set_variable = {
			price_of_goods = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			ROOT.purchase_amount = 0
		}
	}

	every_other_country = {

			check_variable = {
				cg_durable_export_stock_t2 > 0.99
			}
			NOT = {
				tag = ROOT
			}
			check_variable = {
				ROOT.trade_embargo_check^THIS = 0
			}
			NOT = {
				has_war_with = ROOT
			}
		}
		clear_array = CgDurableT2CurrentExport
		for_loop_effect = {

			value = v

				set_country_flag = found
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
			add_to_array = { ROOT.CgVehiclesT2_Import_List = THIS.id }
		}
		clr_country_flag = found

		for_loop_effect = {
			end = CgVehiclesT2_Export_List
			value = v
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { CgVehiclesT2_Export_List^v = ROOT.id }
				}
				set_country_flag = found
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
			add_to_array = { CgVehiclesT2_Export_List = ROOT.id }
		}
		clr_country_flag = found

		subtract_from_variable = {
			ROOT.purchase_amount = ROOT.purchase_amount_prior
		}
		subtract_from_variable = {
			currentAvailableCgVehiclesT2Export = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_used = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		subtract_from_variable = {
			ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			currentExportedCgVehiclesT2 = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.cgVehiclesT2Imports = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		set_variable = {
			CgVehiclesT2ExportTarget^ROOT = ROOT.id
		} 
		add_to_variable = {
			CgVehiclesT2ExportTargetAmount^ROOT = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		set_variable = {
			price_of_goods = cgVehiclesT2ExporterPrice^ROOT
		}
		multiply_variable = {
			price_of_goods = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		add_to_variable = {
			CgVehiclesT2ExportTargetMonthly^ROOT = price_of_goods
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.CgVehiclesT2ImportTargetMonthly^THIS = price_of_goods
		}
		set_variable = {
			ROOT.CgVehiclesT2ImportTarget^THIS = THIS.id
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.CgVehiclesT2ImportTargetAmount^THIS = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		set_variable = {
			price_of_goods = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			ROOT.purchase_amount = 0
		}
	}

	every_other_country = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				cg_vehicles_export_stock_t2 > 0.99
			}
			NOT = {
				tag = ROOT
			}
			check_variable = {
				ROOT.trade_embargo_check^THIS = 0
			}
			NOT = {
				has_war_with = ROOT
			}
		}
		clear_array = CgVehiclesT2CurrentExport
		for_loop_effect = {
			end = CgVehiclesT2ExportTarget^num
			value = v
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { CgVehiclesT2ExportTarget^v = ROOT.id }
				}
				add_to_array = { CgVehiclesT2CurrentExport = CgVehiclesT2ExportTargetAmount^i }

			}
			else = {
				add_to_array = { CgVehiclesT2CurrentExport = 0 }

			}
		}
	}
}

		set_variable = {
			CgElectronicsT3ExportTarget^ROOT = ROOT.id
		} 
		add_to_variable = {
			CgElectronicsT3ExportTargetAmount^ROOT = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		set_variable = {
			price_of_goods = cgElectronicsT3ExporterPrice^ROOT
		}
		multiply_variable = {
			price_of_goods = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		add_to_variable = {
			CgElectronicsT3ExportTargetMonthly^ROOT = price_of_goods
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.CgElectronicsT3ImportTargetMonthly^THIS = price_of_goods
		}
		set_variable = {
			ROOT.CgElectronicsT3ImportTarget^THIS = THIS.id
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.CgElectronicsT3ImportTargetAmount^THIS = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		set_variable = {
			price_of_goods = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			ROOT.purchase_amount = 0
		}
	}

	every_other_country = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				cg_consumer_electronics_export_stock_t3 > 0.99
			}
			NOT = {
				tag = ROOT
			}
			check_variable = {
				ROOT.trade_embargo_check^THIS = 0
			}
			NOT = {
				has_war_with = ROOT
			}
		}
		clear_array = CgElectronicsT3CurrentExport
		for_loop_effect = {
			end = CgElectronicsT3ExportTarget^num
			value = v
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { CgElectronicsT3ExportTarget^v = ROOT.id }
				}
				add_to_array = { CgElectronicsT3CurrentExport = CgElectronicsT3ExportTargetAmount^i }

			}
			else = {
				add_to_array = { CgElectronicsT3CurrentExport = 0 }

			}
		}
	}
}
buy_cg_electronics_t4 = {

	var:currentPurchaser = {
		for_loop_effect = {
			end = ROOT.CgElectronicsT4_Import_List
			value = v
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { CgElectronicsT4_Import_List^v = THIS.id }
				}
				set_country_flag = found
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
			add_to_array = { ROOT.CgElectronicsT4_Import_List = THIS.id }
		}
		clr_country_flag = found

		for_loop_effect = {
			end = CgElectronicsT4_Export_List
			value = v
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { CgElectronicsT4_Export_List^v = ROOT.id }
				}
				set_country_flag = found
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
			add_to_array = { CgElectronicsT4_Export_List = ROOT.id }
		}
		clr_country_flag = found

		subtract_from_variable = {
			ROOT.purchase_amount = ROOT.purchase_amount_prior
		}
		subtract_from_variable = {
			currentAvailableCgElectronicsT4Export = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_used = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		subtract_from_variable = {
			ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			currentExportedCgElectronicsT4 = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.cgElectronicsT4Imports = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		set_variable = {
			CgElectronicsT4ExportTarget^ROOT = ROOT.id
		} 
		add_to_variable = {
			CgElectronicsT4ExportTargetAmount^ROOT = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		set_variable = {
			price_of_goods = cgElectronicsT4ExporterPrice^ROOT
		}
		multiply_variable = {
			price_of_goods = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		add_to_variable = {
			CgElectronicsT4ExportTargetMonthly^ROOT = price_of_goods
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.CgElectronicsT4ImportTargetMonthly^THIS = price_of_goods
		}
		set_variable = {
			ROOT.CgElectronicsT4ImportTarget^THIS = THIS.id
		}
		add_to_variable = {
			ROOT.CgElectronicsT4ImportTargetAmount^THIS = ROOT.purchase_amount
		}

		set_variable = {
			price_of_goods = 0
		}
		set_variable = {
			ROOT.purchase_amount = 0
		}
	}

	every_other_country = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				cg_consumer_electronics_export_stock_t4 > 0.99
			}
			NOT = {
				tag = ROOT
			}
			check_variable = {
				ROOT.trade_embargo_check^THIS = 0
			}
			NOT = {
				has_war_with = ROOT
			}
		}
		clear_array = CgElectronicsT4CurrentExport
		for_loop_effect = {
			end = CgElectronicsT4ExportTarget^num
			value = v
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { CgElectronicsT4ExportTarget^v = ROOT.id }
				}
				add_to_array = { CgElectronicsT4CurrentExport = CgElectronicsT4ExportTargetAmount^i }

			}
			else = {
				add_to_array = { CgElectronicsT4CurrentExport = 0 }

			}
		}
	}
}

# ===== <cgCatT>DeliveryCuts
cgBasicT0DeliveryCuts = {
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				currentAvailableCgBasicT0Export < 0
			}

            any_of = {
                array = CgBasicT0_Export_List
                check_variable = { ROOT.CgBasicT0ExportTargetAmount^THIS > 0 }
            }
        }

		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = CgBasicT0_Export_List

			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { ROOT.currentAvailableCgBasicT0Export < 0 }
					check_variable = { ROOT.CgBasicT0ExportTargetAmount^THIS > 0 }
				}



				subtract_from_variable = {
					ROOT.currentExportedCgBasicT0 = 1
				}

				set_variable = {
					priorExportTotal = ROOT.CgBasicT0ExportTargetMonthly^THIS
				}
				set_variable = {
					priorExportCash = ROOT.CgBasicT0ExportTargetAmount^THIS
				}
				divide_variable = {
					priorExportTotal = priorExportCash
				}

				add_to_variable = {
					ROOT.currentAvailableCgBasicT0Export = 1
				}
				add_to_variable = {
					trade_infrastructure_total_available = 1
				}
				subtract_from_variable = {
					trade_infrastructure_total_used = 1
				}
				subtract_from_variable = {
					cgBasicT0Imports = 1
				}

				subtract_from_variable = {
					ROOT.CgBasicT0ExportTargetAmount^THIS = 1
				}
				add_to_variable = {
					CgBasicT0ImportTargetAmount^ROOT = -1
				}

				subtract_from_variable = {
					ROOT.CgBasicT0ExportTargetMonthly^THIS = priorExportTotal
				}
				subtract_from_variable = {
					CgBasicT0ImportTargetMonthly^ROOT = priorExportTotal
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

					priorExportTotal = priorExportCash
				}

				add_to_variable = {
					ROOT.currentAvailableCgElectronicsT3Export = 1
				}
				add_to_variable = {
					trade_infrastructure_total_available = 1
				}
				subtract_from_variable = {
					trade_infrastructure_total_used = 1
				}
				subtract_from_variable = {
					cgElectronicsT3Imports = 1
				}

				subtract_from_variable = {
					ROOT.CgElectronicsT3ExportTargetAmount^THIS = 1
				}
				add_to_variable = {
					CgElectronicsT3ImportTargetAmount^ROOT = -1
				}

				subtract_from_variable = {
					ROOT.CgElectronicsT3ExportTargetMonthly^THIS = priorExportTotal
				}
				subtract_from_variable = {
					CgElectronicsT3ImportTargetMonthly^ROOT = priorExportTotal
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
cgElectronicsT4DeliveryCuts = {
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
				currentAvailableCgElectronicsT4Export < 0
			}

            any_of = {
                array = CgElectronicsT4_Export_List
                check_variable = { ROOT.CgElectronicsT4ExportTargetAmount^THIS > 0 }
            }
        }

		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = CgElectronicsT4_Export_List

			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { ROOT.currentAvailableCgElectronicsT4Export < 0 }
					check_variable = { ROOT.CgElectronicsT4ExportTargetAmount^THIS > 0 }
				}



				subtract_from_variable = {
					ROOT.currentExportedCgElectronicsT4 = 1
				}

				set_variable = {
					priorExportTotal = ROOT.CgElectronicsT4ExportTargetMonthly^THIS
				}
				set_variable = {
					priorExportCash = ROOT.CgElectronicsT4ExportTargetAmount^THIS
				}
				divide_variable = {
					priorExportTotal = priorExportCash
				}

				add_to_variable = {
					ROOT.currentAvailableCgElectronicsT4Export = 1
				}
				add_to_variable = {
					trade_infrastructure_total_available = 1
				}
				subtract_from_variable = {
					trade_infrastructure_total_used = 1
				}
				subtract_from_variable = {
					cgElectronicsT4Imports = 1
				}

				subtract_from_variable = {
					ROOT.CgElectronicsT4ExportTargetAmount^THIS = 1
				}
				add_to_variable = {
					CgElectronicsT4ImportTargetAmount^ROOT = -1
				}

				subtract_from_variable = {
					ROOT.CgElectronicsT4ExportTargetMonthly^THIS = priorExportTotal
				}
				subtract_from_variable = {
					CgElectronicsT4ImportTargetMonthly^ROOT = priorExportTotal
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# ===== cwic_ai_import_<cg_name_t>
cwic_ai_import_cg_basic_t0 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cg_basic_ai_need > 0.99 }
			check_variable = { trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 }
		}

		generate_available_cg_basic_t0_import_array = yes

		# PERF: lazy cheapest-first pick, O(k*E) instead of the O(E^2) full
		# selection sort in sort_price_number_cg_basic_t0 (which also does per-importer
		# GUI bookkeeping the AI never reads). The trade GUI still uses the sort.
		clear_array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = ROOT.cgBasicT0Exporters
			add_to_array = { PREV.cwic_ai_price_scratch = cgBasicT0ExporterPrice^ROOT }
		}

		set_temp_variable = { cheapest_brk = 0 }

		for_loop_effect = {
			end = ROOT.cgBasicT0Exporters^num
			value = cheap_i
			break = cheapest_brk

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cheapest_brk = 0 } }
				find_lowest_in_array = {
					array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch
					value = cheap_price
					index = cheap_idx
				}
				set_variable = { ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch^cheap_idx = 1000000000 }
				set_temp_variable = { cheap_exporter = ROOT.cgBasicT0Exporters^cheap_idx }
				var:cheap_exporter = {

			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { ROOT.cg_basic_ai_need > 0.99 }
					check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 }
					check_variable = { currentAvailableCgBasicT0Export > 0.99 }
				}

				set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = ROOT.cg_basic_ai_need }

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { currentAvailableCgBasicT0Export < ROOT.purchase_amount } }
					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = currentAvailableCgBasicT0Export }
				}

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available < ROOT.purchase_amount } }
					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available }
				}

				round_variable = ROOT.purchase_amount

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount > 0.99 } }

					subtract_from_variable = { ROOT.cg_basic_ai_need = ROOT.purchase_amount }

					# Write import/export relationship arrays
					for_loop_effect = {
						end = ROOT.CgBasicT0_Import_List
						value = v
						if = {
							limit = {
								check_variable = { CgBasicT0_Import_List^v = THIS.id }
							}
							set_country_flag = found
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
						add_to_array = { ROOT.CgBasicT0_Import_List = THIS.id }
					}
					clr_country_flag = found

					for_loop_effect = {
						end = CgBasicT0_Export_List
						value = v
						if = {
							limit = {
								check_variable = { CgBasicT0_Export_List^v = ROOT.id }
							}
							set_country_flag = found
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
						add_to_array = { CgBasicT0_Export_List = ROOT.id }
					}
					clr_country_flag = found

					# Apply trade contract
					subtract_from_variable = {
						currentAvailableCgBasicT0Export = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_used = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					subtract_from_variable = {
						ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						currentExportedCgBasicT0 = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.cgBasicT0Imports = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = {
						CgBasicT0ExportTarget^ROOT = ROOT.id
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						CgBasicT0ExportTargetAmount^ROOT = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = {
						price_of_goods = cgBasicT0ExporterPrice^ROOT
					}
					multiply_variable = {
						price_of_goods = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					add_to_variable = {
						CgBasicT0ExportTargetMonthly^ROOT = price_of_goods
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.CgBasicT0ImportTargetMonthly^THIS = price_of_goods
					}
					set_variable = {
						ROOT.CgBasicT0ImportTarget^THIS = THIS.id
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.CgBasicT0ImportTargetAmount^THIS = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = { price_of_goods = 0 }

					if = {
						limit = {
							check_variable = { currentAvailableCgBasicT0Export < 0 }
						}
						country_event = trade.40
					}

					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = 0 }
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.cg_basic_ai_need > 0.99 } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 } }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cheapest_brk = 1 }
			}
				}
			}
		}
		clear_array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch

	}

	clear_variable = cheapest_brk
}

						add_to_array = { ROOT.CgBasicT1_Import_List = THIS.id }
					}
					clr_country_flag = found

					for_loop_effect = {
						end = CgBasicT1_Export_List
						value = v
						if = {
							limit = {
								check_variable = { CgBasicT1_Export_List^v = ROOT.id }
							}
							set_country_flag = found
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
						add_to_array = { CgBasicT1_Export_List = ROOT.id }
					}
					clr_country_flag = found

					# Apply trade contract
					subtract_from_variable = {
						currentAvailableCgBasicT1Export = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_used = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					subtract_from_variable = {
						ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						currentExportedCgBasicT1 = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {

					}

					}

						ROOT.CgBasicT1ImportTargetMonthly^THIS = price_of_goods
					}
					set_variable = {
						ROOT.CgBasicT1ImportTarget^THIS = THIS.id
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.CgBasicT1ImportTargetAmount^THIS = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = { price_of_goods = 0 }

					if = {
						limit = {

						}
						country_event = trade.20
					}

cwic_ai_import_cg_basic_t3 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cg_basic_ai_need > 0.99 }
			check_variable = { trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 }
		}

		generate_available_cg_basic_t3_import_array = yes

		# PERF: lazy cheapest-first pick, O(k*E) instead of the O(E^2) full

		}

			end = ROOT.cgBasicT3Exporters^num
			value = cheap_i
			break = cheapest_brk

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cheapest_brk = 0 } }

					array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch

					index = cheap_idx

				}

				round_variable = ROOT.purchase_amount

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount > 0.99 } }

					subtract_from_variable = { ROOT.cg_basic_ai_need = ROOT.purchase_amount }

					# Write import/export relationship arrays
					for_loop_effect = {
						end = ROOT.CgBasicT3_Import_List
						value = v
						if = {
							limit = {
								check_variable = { CgBasicT3_Import_List^v = THIS.id }
							}
							set_country_flag = found
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
						add_to_array = { ROOT.CgBasicT3_Import_List = THIS.id }
					}
					clr_country_flag = found

					for_loop_effect = {
						end = CgBasicT3_Export_List
						value = v
						if = {
							limit = {
								check_variable = { CgBasicT3_Export_List^v = ROOT.id }
							}
							set_country_flag = found
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
						add_to_array = { CgBasicT3_Export_List = ROOT.id }
					}
					clr_country_flag = found

					# Apply trade contract
					subtract_from_variable = {
						currentAvailableCgBasicT3Export = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_used = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					subtract_from_variable = {
						ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						currentExportedCgBasicT3 = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.cgBasicT3Imports = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = {
						CgBasicT3ExportTarget^ROOT = ROOT.id
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						CgBasicT3ExportTargetAmount^ROOT = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = {
						price_of_goods = cgBasicT3ExporterPrice^ROOT
					}
					multiply_variable = {
						price_of_goods = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					add_to_variable = {
						CgBasicT3ExportTargetMonthly^ROOT = price_of_goods
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.CgBasicT3ImportTargetMonthly^THIS = price_of_goods
					}
					set_variable = {
						ROOT.CgBasicT3ImportTarget^THIS = THIS.id
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.CgBasicT3ImportTargetAmount^THIS = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = { price_of_goods = 0 }

					if = {
						limit = {
							check_variable = { currentAvailableCgBasicT3Export < 0 }
						}
						country_event = trade.22
					}

					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = 0 }
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.cg_basic_ai_need > 0.99 } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 } }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cheapest_brk = 1 }
			}
				}
			}
		}
		clear_array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch

	}

	clear_variable = cheapest_brk
}
cwic_ai_import_cg_basic_t4 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cg_basic_ai_need > 0.99 }
			check_variable = { trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 }
		}

		generate_available_cg_basic_t4_import_array = yes

		# PERF: lazy cheapest-first pick, O(k*E) instead of the O(E^2) full
		# selection sort in sort_price_number_cg_basic_t4 (which also does per-importer
		# GUI bookkeeping the AI never reads). The trade GUI still uses the sort.
		clear_array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = ROOT.cgBasicT4Exporters
			add_to_array = { PREV.cwic_ai_price_scratch = cgBasicT4ExporterPrice^ROOT }
		}

		set_temp_variable = { cheapest_brk = 0 }

		for_loop_effect = {
			end = ROOT.cgBasicT4Exporters^num
			value = cheap_i
			break = cheapest_brk

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cheapest_brk = 0 } }
				find_lowest_in_array = {
					array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch
					value = cheap_price
					index = cheap_idx
				}
				set_variable = { ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch^cheap_idx = 1000000000 }
				set_temp_variable = { cheap_exporter = ROOT.cgBasicT4Exporters^cheap_idx }
				var:cheap_exporter = {

			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { ROOT.cg_basic_ai_need > 0.99 }
					check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 }
					check_variable = { currentAvailableCgBasicT4Export > 0.99 }
				}

				set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = ROOT.cg_basic_ai_need }

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { currentAvailableCgBasicT4Export < ROOT.purchase_amount } }
					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = currentAvailableCgBasicT4Export }
				}

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available < ROOT.purchase_amount } }
					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available }
				}

				round_variable = ROOT.purchase_amount

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount > 0.99 } }

					subtract_from_variable = { ROOT.cg_basic_ai_need = ROOT.purchase_amount }

					# Write import/export relationship arrays
					for_loop_effect = {
						end = ROOT.CgBasicT4_Import_List
						value = v
						if = {
							limit = {
								check_variable = { CgBasicT4_Import_List^v = THIS.id }
							}
							set_country_flag = found
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
						add_to_array = { ROOT.CgBasicT4_Import_List = THIS.id }
					}
					clr_country_flag = found

					for_loop_effect = {
						end = CgBasicT4_Export_List
						value = v
						if = {
							limit = {
								check_variable = { CgBasicT4_Export_List^v = ROOT.id }
							}
							set_country_flag = found
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
						add_to_array = { CgBasicT4_Export_List = ROOT.id }
					}
					clr_country_flag = found

					# Apply trade contract
					subtract_from_variable = {
						currentAvailableCgBasicT4Export = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_used = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					subtract_from_variable = {
						ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						currentExportedCgBasicT4 = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.cgBasicT4Imports = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = {
						CgBasicT4ExportTarget^ROOT = ROOT.id
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						CgBasicT4ExportTargetAmount^ROOT = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = {
						price_of_goods = cgBasicT4ExporterPrice^ROOT
					}
					multiply_variable = {
						price_of_goods = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					add_to_variable = {
						CgBasicT4ExportTargetMonthly^ROOT = price_of_goods
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.CgBasicT4ImportTargetMonthly^THIS = price_of_goods
					}
					set_variable = {
						ROOT.CgBasicT4ImportTarget^THIS = THIS.id
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.CgBasicT4ImportTargetAmount^THIS = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = { price_of_goods = 0 }

					if = {
						limit = {
							check_variable = { currentAvailableCgBasicT4Export < 0 }
						}
						country_event = trade.23
					}

					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = 0 }
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.cg_basic_ai_need > 0.99 } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 } }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cheapest_brk = 1 }
			}
				}
			}
		}
		clear_array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch

	}

	clear_variable = cheapest_brk
}

						add_to_array = { CgDurableT1_Export_List = ROOT.id }
					}
					clr_country_flag = found

					# Apply trade contract
					subtract_from_variable = {
						currentAvailableCgDurableT1Export = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_used = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					subtract_from_variable = {
						ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						currentExportedCgDurableT1 = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.cgDurableT1Imports = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = {
						CgDurableT1ExportTarget^ROOT = ROOT.id
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						CgDurableT1ExportTargetAmount^ROOT = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = {
						price_of_goods = cgDurableT1ExporterPrice^ROOT
					}
					multiply_variable = {
						price_of_goods = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					add_to_variable = {
						CgDurableT1ExportTargetMonthly^ROOT = price_of_goods
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.CgDurableT1ImportTargetMonthly^THIS = price_of_goods
					}
					set_variable = {
						ROOT.CgDurableT1ImportTarget^THIS = THIS.id
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.CgDurableT1ImportTargetAmount^THIS = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = { price_of_goods = 0 }

					if = {
						limit = {
							check_variable = { currentAvailableCgDurableT1Export < 0 }
						}
						country_event = trade.25
					}

					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = 0 }
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.cg_durable_ai_need > 0.99 } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 } }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cheapest_brk = 1 }
			}
				}
			}
		}
		clear_array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch

	}

	clear_variable = cheapest_brk
}
cwic_ai_import_cg_durable_t2 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cg_durable_ai_need > 0.99 }
			check_variable = { trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 }
		}

		generate_available_cg_durable_t2_import_array = yes

		# PERF: lazy cheapest-first pick, O(k*E) instead of the O(E^2) full
		# selection sort in sort_price_number_cg_durable_t2 (which also does per-importer
		# GUI bookkeeping the AI never reads). The trade GUI still uses the sort.
		clear_array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = ROOT.cgDurableT2Exporters
			add_to_array = { PREV.cwic_ai_price_scratch = cgDurableT2ExporterPrice^ROOT }
		}

		set_temp_variable = { cheapest_brk = 0 }

		for_loop_effect = {
			end = ROOT.cgDurableT2Exporters^num
			value = cheap_i
			break = cheapest_brk

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cheapest_brk = 0 } }
				find_lowest_in_array = {
					array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch
					value = cheap_price
					index = cheap_idx
				}
				set_variable = { ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch^cheap_idx = 1000000000 }
				set_temp_variable = { cheap_exporter = ROOT.cgDurableT2Exporters^cheap_idx }
				var:cheap_exporter = {

			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { ROOT.cg_durable_ai_need > 0.99 }
					check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 }
					check_variable = { currentAvailableCgDurableT2Export > 0.99 }
				}

				set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = ROOT.cg_durable_ai_need }

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { currentAvailableCgDurableT2Export < ROOT.purchase_amount } }
					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = currentAvailableCgDurableT2Export }
				}

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available < ROOT.purchase_amount } }
					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available }
				}

				round_variable = ROOT.purchase_amount

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount > 0.99 } }

					subtract_from_variable = { ROOT.cg_durable_ai_need = ROOT.purchase_amount }

					# Write import/export relationship arrays
					for_loop_effect = {
						end = ROOT.CgDurableT2_Import_List
						value = v
						if = {
							limit = {
								check_variable = { CgDurableT2_Import_List^v = THIS.id }
							}
							set_country_flag = found
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
						add_to_array = { ROOT.CgDurableT2_Import_List = THIS.id }
					}
					clr_country_flag = found

					for_loop_effect = {
						end = CgDurableT2_Export_List
						value = v
						if = {
							limit = {
								check_variable = { CgDurableT2_Export_List^v = ROOT.id }
							}
							set_country_flag = found
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
						add_to_array = { CgDurableT2_Export_List = ROOT.id }
					}
					clr_country_flag = found

					# Apply trade contract
					subtract_from_variable = {
						currentAvailableCgDurableT2Export = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_used = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					subtract_from_variable = {
						ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						currentExportedCgDurableT2 = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.cgDurableT2Imports = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = {
						CgDurableT2ExportTarget^ROOT = ROOT.id
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						CgDurableT2ExportTargetAmount^ROOT = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = {
						price_of_goods = cgDurableT2ExporterPrice^ROOT
					}
					multiply_variable = {
						price_of_goods = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					add_to_variable = {
						CgDurableT2ExportTargetMonthly^ROOT = price_of_goods
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.CgDurableT2ImportTargetMonthly^THIS = price_of_goods
					}
					set_variable = {
						ROOT.CgDurableT2ImportTarget^THIS = THIS.id
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.CgDurableT2ImportTargetAmount^THIS = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = { price_of_goods = 0 }

					if = {
						limit = {
							check_variable = { currentAvailableCgDurableT2Export < 0 }
						}
						country_event = trade.26
					}

					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = 0 }
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.cg_durable_ai_need > 0.99 } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 } }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cheapest_brk = 1 }
			}
				}
			}
		}
		clear_array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch

	}

	clear_variable = cheapest_brk
}

					multiply_variable = {
						price_of_goods = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					add_to_variable = {
						CgDurableT5ExportTargetMonthly^ROOT = price_of_goods
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.CgDurableT5ImportTargetMonthly^THIS = price_of_goods
					}
					set_variable = {
						ROOT.CgDurableT5ImportTarget^THIS = THIS.id
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.CgDurableT5ImportTargetAmount^THIS = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = { price_of_goods = 0 }

					if = {
						limit = {
							check_variable = { currentAvailableCgDurableT5Export < 0 }
						}
						country_event = trade.29
					}

					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = 0 }
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.cg_durable_ai_need > 0.99 } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 } }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cheapest_brk = 1 }
			}
				}
			}
		}
		clear_array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch

	}

	clear_variable = cheapest_brk
}
cwic_ai_import_cg_vehicles_t0 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cg_vehicles_ai_need > 0.99 }
			check_variable = { trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 }
		}

		generate_available_cg_vehicles_t0_import_array = yes

		# PERF: lazy cheapest-first pick, O(k*E) instead of the O(E^2) full
		# selection sort in sort_price_number_cg_vehicles_t0 (which also does per-importer
		# GUI bookkeeping the AI never reads). The trade GUI still uses the sort.
		clear_array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = ROOT.cgVehiclesT0Exporters
			add_to_array = { PREV.cwic_ai_price_scratch = cgVehiclesT0ExporterPrice^ROOT }
		}

		set_temp_variable = { cheapest_brk = 0 }

		for_loop_effect = {
			end = ROOT.cgVehiclesT0Exporters^num
			value = cheap_i
			break = cheapest_brk

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cheapest_brk = 0 } }
				find_lowest_in_array = {
					array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch
					value = cheap_price
					index = cheap_idx
				}
				set_variable = { ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch^cheap_idx = 1000000000 }
				set_temp_variable = { cheap_exporter = ROOT.cgVehiclesT0Exporters^cheap_idx }
				var:cheap_exporter = {

			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { ROOT.cg_vehicles_ai_need > 0.99 }
					check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 }
					check_variable = { currentAvailableCgVehiclesT0Export > 0.99 }
				}

				set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = ROOT.cg_vehicles_ai_need }

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { currentAvailableCgVehiclesT0Export < ROOT.purchase_amount } }
					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = currentAvailableCgVehiclesT0Export }
				}

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available < ROOT.purchase_amount } }
					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available }
				}

				round_variable = ROOT.purchase_amount

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount > 0.99 } }

					subtract_from_variable = { ROOT.cg_vehicles_ai_need = ROOT.purchase_amount }

					# Write import/export relationship arrays
					for_loop_effect = {
						end = ROOT.CgVehiclesT0_Import_List
						value = v
						if = {
							limit = {
								check_variable = { CgVehiclesT0_Import_List^v = THIS.id }
							}
							set_country_flag = found
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
						add_to_array = { ROOT.CgVehiclesT0_Import_List = THIS.id }
					}
					clr_country_flag = found

					for_loop_effect = {
						end = CgVehiclesT0_Export_List
						value = v
						if = {
							limit = {
								check_variable = { CgVehiclesT0_Export_List^v = ROOT.id }
							}
							set_country_flag = found
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
						add_to_array = { CgVehiclesT0_Export_List = ROOT.id }
					}
					clr_country_flag = found

					# Apply trade contract
					subtract_from_variable = {
						currentAvailableCgVehiclesT0Export = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_used = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					subtract_from_variable = {
						ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						currentExportedCgVehiclesT0 = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.cgVehiclesT0Imports = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = {
						CgVehiclesT0ExportTarget^ROOT = ROOT.id
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						CgVehiclesT0ExportTargetAmount^ROOT = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = {
						price_of_goods = cgVehiclesT0ExporterPrice^ROOT
					}
					multiply_variable = {
						price_of_goods = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					add_to_variable = {
						CgVehiclesT0ExportTargetMonthly^ROOT = price_of_goods
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.CgVehiclesT0ImportTargetMonthly^THIS = price_of_goods
					}
					set_variable = {
						ROOT.CgVehiclesT0ImportTarget^THIS = THIS.id
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.CgVehiclesT0ImportTargetAmount^THIS = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = { price_of_goods = 0 }

					if = {
						limit = {
							check_variable = { currentAvailableCgVehiclesT0Export < 0 }
						}
						country_event = trade.42
					}

					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = 0 }
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.cg_vehicles_ai_need > 0.99 } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 } }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cheapest_brk = 1 }
			}
				}
			}
		}
		clear_array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch

	}

	clear_variable = cheapest_brk
}

					if = {
						limit = {
							check_variable = { currentAvailableCgVehiclesT3Export < 0 }
						}
						country_event = trade.32
					}

					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = 0 }
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.cg_vehicles_ai_need > 0.99 } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 } }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cheapest_brk = 1 }
			}
				}
			}
		}
		clear_array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch

	}

	clear_variable = cheapest_brk
}
cwic_ai_import_cg_vehicles_t4 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cg_vehicles_ai_need > 0.99 }
			check_variable = { trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 }
		}

		generate_available_cg_vehicles_t4_import_array = yes

		# PERF: lazy cheapest-first pick, O(k*E) instead of the O(E^2) full
		# selection sort in sort_price_number_cg_vehicles_t4 (which also does per-importer
		# GUI bookkeeping the AI never reads). The trade GUI still uses the sort.
		clear_array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = ROOT.cgVehiclesT4Exporters
			add_to_array = { PREV.cwic_ai_price_scratch = cgVehiclesT4ExporterPrice^ROOT }
		}

		set_temp_variable = { cheapest_brk = 0 }

		for_loop_effect = {
			end = ROOT.cgVehiclesT4Exporters^num
			value = cheap_i
			break = cheapest_brk

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cheapest_brk = 0 } }
				find_lowest_in_array = {
					array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch
					value = cheap_price
					index = cheap_idx
				}
				set_variable = { ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch^cheap_idx = 1000000000 }
				set_temp_variable = { cheap_exporter = ROOT.cgVehiclesT4Exporters^cheap_idx }
				var:cheap_exporter = {

			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { ROOT.cg_vehicles_ai_need > 0.99 }
					check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 }
					check_variable = { currentAvailableCgVehiclesT4Export > 0.99 }
				}

				set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = ROOT.cg_vehicles_ai_need }

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { currentAvailableCgVehiclesT4Export < ROOT.purchase_amount } }
					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = currentAvailableCgVehiclesT4Export }
				}

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available < ROOT.purchase_amount } }
					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available }
				}

				round_variable = ROOT.purchase_amount

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount > 0.99 } }

					subtract_from_variable = { ROOT.cg_vehicles_ai_need = ROOT.purchase_amount }

					# Write import/export relationship arrays
					for_loop_effect = {
						end = ROOT.CgVehiclesT4_Import_List
						value = v
						if = {
							limit = {
								check_variable = { CgVehiclesT4_Import_List^v = THIS.id }
							}
							set_country_flag = found
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
						add_to_array = { ROOT.CgVehiclesT4_Import_List = THIS.id }
					}
					clr_country_flag = found

					for_loop_effect = {
						end = CgVehiclesT4_Export_List
						value = v
						if = {
							limit = {
								check_variable = { CgVehiclesT4_Export_List^v = ROOT.id }
							}
							set_country_flag = found
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
						add_to_array = { CgVehiclesT4_Export_List = ROOT.id }
					}
					clr_country_flag = found

					# Apply trade contract
					subtract_from_variable = {
						currentAvailableCgVehiclesT4Export = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_used = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					subtract_from_variable = {
						ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						currentExportedCgVehiclesT4 = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.cgVehiclesT4Imports = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = {
						CgVehiclesT4ExportTarget^ROOT = ROOT.id
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						CgVehiclesT4ExportTargetAmount^ROOT = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = {
						price_of_goods = cgVehiclesT4ExporterPrice^ROOT
					}
					multiply_variable = {
						price_of_goods = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					add_to_variable = {
						CgVehiclesT4ExportTargetMonthly^ROOT = price_of_goods
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.CgVehiclesT4ImportTargetMonthly^THIS = price_of_goods
					}
					set_variable = {
						ROOT.CgVehiclesT4ImportTarget^THIS = THIS.id
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.CgVehiclesT4ImportTargetAmount^THIS = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = { price_of_goods = 0 }

					if = {
						limit = {
							check_variable = { currentAvailableCgVehiclesT4Export < 0 }
						}
						country_event = trade.33
					}

					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = 0 }
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.cg_vehicles_ai_need > 0.99 } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 } }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cheapest_brk = 1 }
			}
				}
			}
		}
		clear_array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch

	}

	clear_variable = cheapest_brk
}

	clear_variable = cheapest_brk
}
cwic_ai_import_cg_electronics_t3 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { cg_electronics_ai_need > 0.99 }
			check_variable = { trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 }
		}

		generate_available_cg_consumer_electronics_t3_import_array = yes

		# PERF: lazy cheapest-first pick, O(k*E) instead of the O(E^2) full
		# selection sort in sort_price_number_cg_electronics_t3 (which also does per-importer
		# GUI bookkeeping the AI never reads). The trade GUI still uses the sort.
		clear_array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = ROOT.cgElectronicsT3Exporters
			add_to_array = { PREV.cwic_ai_price_scratch = cgElectronicsT3ExporterPrice^ROOT }
		}

		set_temp_variable = { cheapest_brk = 0 }

		for_loop_effect = {
			end = ROOT.cgElectronicsT3Exporters^num
			value = cheap_i
			break = cheapest_brk

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cheapest_brk = 0 } }
				find_lowest_in_array = {
					array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch
					value = cheap_price
					index = cheap_idx
				}
				set_variable = { ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch^cheap_idx = 1000000000 }
				set_temp_variable = { cheap_exporter = ROOT.cgElectronicsT3Exporters^cheap_idx }
				var:cheap_exporter = {

			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { ROOT.cg_electronics_ai_need > 0.99 }
					check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 }
					check_variable = { currentAvailableCgElectronicsT3Export > 0.99 }
				}

				set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = ROOT.cg_electronics_ai_need }

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { currentAvailableCgElectronicsT3Export < ROOT.purchase_amount } }
					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = currentAvailableCgElectronicsT3Export }
				}

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available < ROOT.purchase_amount } }
					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available }
				}

				round_variable = ROOT.purchase_amount

				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount > 0.99 } }

					subtract_from_variable = { ROOT.cg_electronics_ai_need = ROOT.purchase_amount }

					# Write import/export relationship arrays
					for_loop_effect = {
						end = ROOT.CgElectronicsT3_Import_List
						value = v
						if = {
							limit = {
								check_variable = { CgElectronicsT3_Import_List^v = THIS.id }
							}
							set_country_flag = found
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
						add_to_array = { ROOT.CgElectronicsT3_Import_List = THIS.id }
					}
					clr_country_flag = found

					for_loop_effect = {
						end = CgElectronicsT3_Export_List
						value = v
						if = {
							limit = {
								check_variable = { CgElectronicsT3_Export_List^v = ROOT.id }
							}
							set_country_flag = found
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = found } }
						add_to_array = { CgElectronicsT3_Export_List = ROOT.id }
					}
					clr_country_flag = found

					# Apply trade contract
					subtract_from_variable = {
						currentAvailableCgElectronicsT3Export = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_used = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					subtract_from_variable = {
						ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						currentExportedCgElectronicsT3 = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.cgElectronicsT3Imports = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = {
						CgElectronicsT3ExportTarget^ROOT = ROOT.id
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						CgElectronicsT3ExportTargetAmount^ROOT = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = {
						price_of_goods = cgElectronicsT3ExporterPrice^ROOT
					}
					multiply_variable = {
						price_of_goods = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					add_to_variable = {
						CgElectronicsT3ExportTargetMonthly^ROOT = price_of_goods
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.CgElectronicsT3ImportTargetMonthly^THIS = price_of_goods
					}
					set_variable = {
						ROOT.CgElectronicsT3ImportTarget^THIS = THIS.id
					}
					add_to_variable = {
						ROOT.CgElectronicsT3ImportTargetAmount^THIS = ROOT.purchase_amount
					}

					set_variable = { price_of_goods = 0 }

					if = {
						limit = {
							check_variable = { currentAvailableCgElectronicsT3Export < 0 }
						}
						country_event = trade.37
					}

					set_variable = { ROOT.purchase_amount = 0 }
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.cg_electronics_ai_need > 0.99 } }
						NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.trade_infrastructure_total_available > 0.99 } }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cheapest_brk = 1 }
			}
				}
			}
		}
		clear_array = ROOT.cwic_ai_price_scratch

	}

	clear_variable = cheapest_brk
}
